items.title: What Does Carvana (CVNA) Same Day Delivery Expansion Mean For Investors?
items.summary: Carvana (NYSE:CVNA) expanded same day vehicle delivery coverage to southern Maine, New Hampshire, and Rhode Island. The roll out extends the online used car retailer's e commerce and logistics network into additional New England markets. Management framed the move as part of its broader effort to offer end to end digital car buying and selling across more regions.
